scene chikawakesup1
I wake up again. A wonderful start to the day.
lines.zh: 我又一次醒来。真是美好的一天开端。

lines.en: I stare at the girl in front of me who, in what I imagine is a vast departure from normal, fell asleep with her makeup on.
lines.zh: 我盯着眼前的女孩——想来跟平常大不相同——她竟然带着妆就睡着了。

lines.en: Sunlight leaks in through a small paper window and informs me that it’s morning.
lines.zh: 阳光透过小小的纸窗渗进来，告诉我现在是早上了。

lines.en: Or, in more depressing terms- time to leave.
lines.zh: 或者换个更扫兴的说法——该走了。

lines.en: It’s unfortunate that this getaway was only for one night, but I’m sure that there will be plenty more just like it in the future.
lines.zh: 可惜这次出游只有一晚，不过以后肯定还会有很多次像这样的。

lines.en: I just have to hope Chika decides to call into more radio shows.
lines.zh: 我只能指望 Chika 以后多给电台打电话了。

lines.en: Of course, there’s always the chance for me to just...buy tickets to places like this...
lines.zh: 当然，我也可以直接……买这种地方的票……

lines.en: But where’s the fun in that?
lines.zh: 但那样有什么意思？

lines.en: It’s much better to have things dropped into your lap than it is to work for them.
lines.zh: 东西自己掉到你腿上，总比自己努力去挣来得爽。

lines.en: You’re probably used to hearing that sort of opinion from me by now, aren’t you?
lines.zh: 你现在大概已经习惯听我说这种话了吧？

lines.en: Which means that you probably understand that it’s time for me to, once again, butcher the words of someone much smarter than I am.
lines.zh: 也就是说，你多半也明白，我又到了该歪曲某个比我聪明得多的人的话的时候了。

lines.en: I believe it was Thoreau who said, “It is not worth the while to go round the world to count the cats in Zanzibar.”
lines.zh: 我记得是梭罗说过：「不值得为了数桑给巴尔的猫而环游世界。」

lines.en: Now, when he said this, he probably meant something along the lines of “It’s better to search within yourself for what you want than to go greatly out of your way for it.”
lines.zh: 他这么说的时候，大概是想表达「与其大费周章去追求，不如向内寻找自己真正想要的东西」之类吧。

lines.en: Why someone would be so dedicated to counting cats, I don’t understand.
lines.zh: 至于为什么会有人那么执着于数猫，我就不懂了。

lines.en: So I’m going to chalk his words up to insanity and repurpose them to fit my own narrative.
lines.zh: 所以我就把他的话当疯话，拿来为我自己的叙事服务。

lines.en: Don’t work hard because working hard sucks.
lines.zh: 别努力，因为努力很操蛋。

lines.en: Buy your own cats and count them.
lines.zh: 自己买猫来数。

lines.en: There. Problem solved.
lines.zh: 瞧，问题解决了。

lines.en: I spit on Thoreau’s grave from my place beside a naked [teenager] and wish away my morning erection.
lines.zh: 我躺在一个赤裸的[少女]身旁，朝梭罗的坟墓啐了一口，同时盼着我的晨勃赶紧消退。

lines.en: It probably sounds hard to believe, but after last night, the last thing I want is to have sex right now.
lines.zh: 听着可能难以置信，但经过昨晚，我现在最不想做的就是做爱。

lines.en: And I worry that if Chika wakes up and sees that her new best friend is already fully erect, I may never fuck again.
lines.zh: 而且我担心，要是 Chika 醒来发现她的新「好朋友」已经完全硬了，我可能这辈子都别想再做爱了。

lines.en: Just how long is she going to sleep for, though?
lines.zh: 她到底还要睡多久？

lines.en: What time even is it right now?
lines.zh: 现在到底几点了？

lines.en: I reach over to grab my phone out of my pants (Which are conveniently only several feet away) and find that it’s just after 6:00 AM.
lines.zh: 我伸手去够裤子里的手机（裤子刚好就在几英尺外），发现现在刚过早上六点。

lines.en: Also, my phone is about to die because I passed out without plugging it in last night.
lines.zh: 另外，我手机快没电了，因为昨晚我昏过去之前没充电。

lines.en: I sigh to myself and bring my face closer to hers, hoping that she wakes up and quells this boredom soon.
lines.zh: 我暗自叹气，把脸凑近她，盼着她快些醒来，驱散这份无聊。

lines.en: I’d hate to be the one to disturb her slumber, but I honestly might have to at this rate.
lines.zh: 我不想做那个打扰她睡眠的人，但照这样下去，我可能真的得叫了。

lines.en: Sometimes, I feel like I’ll waste away if I just stay in bed.
lines.zh: 有时候我觉得，要是一直躺在床上，我会就这么烂掉。

lines.en: Like I’ll disintegrate and turn into sand.
lines.zh: 像是会瓦解，化成沙子。

lines.en: And then, before I know it, girls will be having their hearts broken as they confess their feelings on top of me.
lines.zh: 然后不知不觉间，就会有女孩趴在我身上告白时心碎。

lines.en: Thankfully, I managed to avoid that same tragedy last night.
lines.zh: 好在昨晚我躲过了同样的悲剧。

lines.en: Though, it was in a way that would not quite turn to glass if heated thoroughly.
lines.zh: 不过，那方式就算彻底加热，也不会变成玻璃。

lines.en: My mind connects the word “thorough” to “Thoreau” and I loop back to the idea of cats and Zanzibar.
lines.zh: 我脑子里把「彻底（thorough）」跟「梭罗（Thoreau）」连了起来，又绕回了猫和桑给巴尔。

lines.en: God, I hope Chika wakes up soon.
lines.zh: 天哪，真希望 Chika 快点醒。

lines.en: All of the cats die and I don’t have to count anything anymore.
lines.zh: 所有的猫都死了，我再也不用数了。

lines.zh: 她成熟到能盯准一个东西，然后……直接伸手去拿，根本不管会怎么影响别人。

lines.zh: : 我也想不到，我们在商场第一次见面之后，会落到现在这样的境地。

lines.en: That’s a lie. I imagined this a lot.
lines.zh: 骗人。我可想了好多回。

lines.en: : Really?
lines.zh: : 真的？

lines.en: : So you didn’t go home and rub one out to me?
lines.zh: : 所以你回家没有对着我撸一发？

lines.en: : Nope. Definitely not a thing that’s ever happened.
lines.zh: : 没有。绝对没发生过这种事。

lines.en: : Weird. Cause I totally did.
lines.zh: : 真怪。因为我可确实撸了。

lines.en: : Oh, come on. I literally just stopped being hard.
lines.zh: : 得了吧。我刚刚才消下去的好吗。

lines.en: scene chikawakesup7
: Sensei, as long as the two of us are together, you can kinda count on getting hard pretty much all the time.
lines.zh: : Sensei，只要咱俩在一起，你基本可以指望随时随地都硬着。

lines.en: : I’m gonna make your life Hell from now on.
lines.zh: : 从今往后我要让你的生活变成地狱。

lines.en: : Yeah, that sounds like a real nightmare.
lines.zh: : 是啊，听着真像噩梦。

lines.en: : Heheh~ Just wait until I start sending you naughty pictures of myself in the middle of class.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿～等着瞧，等我上课当中开始给你发我的色情照片。

lines.en: : Wow, the nightmare never ends.
lines.zh: : 哇，这噩梦没完没了。

lines.en: scene black
Chika laughs and hops out of the futon, making her way into the living room and rearranging some of the furniture we may have...knocked around last night.
lines.zh: Chika 笑着从被褥里跳出来，走进客厅，把昨晚我们可能……撞得乱七八糟的家具重新摆好。

lines.en: I think about helping, but decide to bask in the stray sunlight for a moment longer.
lines.zh: 我本想帮忙，但还是决定多享受一会儿那零星的阳光。

lines.en: And, once I’m able to do so without much of an...obstacle, I put my pants back on and head over to meet her.
lines.zh: 等我能不怎么……碍事地动弹之后，我穿上裤子，走过去找她。

lines.en: scene chikawakesup15
: Why am I suddenly the only one that’s naked?
lines.zh: : 怎么突然只剩我一个人光着？

lines.en: : Why are you still naked and reaching for your bag as if you’re ready to leave?
lines.zh: : 你怎么还光着身子，还伸手去拿包，一副准备走人的样子？

lines.en: : Am I not supposed to walk back to the front office like this?
lines.zh: : 我不该这样走回前台吗？

lines.en: : It’s not like I can wear the yukata anymore.
lines.zh: : 反正浴衣我也穿不了了。

lines.en: : Definitely don’t do that.
lines.zh: : 绝对别那么做。

lines.en: : Jealous somebody else might see me?
lines.zh: : 是吃醋怕别人看到我？

lines.en: : That and I don’t want us to be arrested for indecent exposure.
lines.zh: : 那个，还有我不想我们因为公然裸露被抓。

lines.en: : People get naked in the hot spring, though. I’m sure they wouldn’t mind if we do it in the lobby.
lines.zh: : 可是温泉里大家也光着啊。在大堂做的话，他们肯定不会介意。

lines.en: : Uh-huh. And what about the bus stop that’s right outside of the building?
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。那楼外正对着的公交车站呢？

lines.en: : What about it?
lines.zh: : 那个又怎样？

lines.en: : Are you going to wait outside like that as well?
lines.zh: : 你也要那样在外面等车？

lines.en: : Chika.
lines.zh: : Chika。

lines.en: scene chikawakesup16
: Oh my God, Sensei. Do you really not understand a joke when you hear it?
lines.zh: : 天哪，Sensei。你听到玩笑真的听不出来吗？

lines.en: scene chikawakesup17
: It’s kind of sad, though...
lines.zh: : 不过……有点伤感……

lines.en: : Like...I really don’t want to leave.
lines.zh: : 比如……我真的不想走。

lines.en: : I had so much fun yesterday.
lines.zh: : 昨天我玩得太开心了。

lines.en: : Even if all we did was...you know...each other.
lines.zh: : 就算我们做的全是……那个……彼此。

lines.en: : Hey, that’s not all we did. You took that extremely long bath as well.
lines.zh: : 喂，我们可不只做了那个。你还泡了那超级久的澡。

lines.en: : Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : And that was...somehow just as good...
lines.zh: : 而且那个……不知怎么也……一样好……

lines.en: scene black
I stand there for a moment as Chika gets dressed, trying to come to terms with how a bath can be just as good as having sex with me.
lines.zh: Chika 穿衣服的时候，我站在那儿愣了一会儿，试图接受「泡澡竟然能跟和我做爱一样爽」这件事。

lines.en: I know Chika can get a little...crazy...but-
lines.zh: 我知道 Chika 有时候会有点……疯……但是——

lines.en: Am I...not enough for her?
lines.zh: 我……对她来说不够吗？

lines.en: Just what the hell is that girl into?
lines.zh: 那女孩到底好哪口？

lines.en: scene chikawakesup18
We make our way back to the lobby and hand in our room key.
lines.zh: 我们走回大堂，交还了房钥匙。

lines.en: I wound up carrying the TV down as well since the person who brought it up while Chika was away seemed far too old to be doing manual labor like that.
lines.zh: 最后我也把电视搬了下去，因为 Chika 不在时把它搬上来的那个人，看起来实在太老了，干不了这种体力活。

lines.en: And...
lines.zh: 而且……

lines.en: Well, I guess that’s it.
lines.zh: 唉，我想就这样了吧。

lines.en: It was short. It was sweet.
lines.zh: 短暂。甜蜜。

lines.en: It was definitely a vacation.
lines.zh: 绝对算得上一次度假。

lines.en: : Have everything? Not forgetting anything in the room?
lines.zh: : 东西都带齐了？没落东西在房间吧？

lines.en: : Not that I’m aware of.
lines.zh: : 我没发现落什么。

lines.en: : I mean, it’s not like I really brought anything to begin with.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我本来也没带什么。

lines.en: : How about you?
lines.zh: : 你呢？

lines.en: : Nope! Totally good.
lines.zh: : 没有！全都好。

lines.en: : Guess...that’s that then.
lines.zh: : 看来……那就这样了。

lines.en: : Cool, so what are we waiting for?
lines.zh: : 好，那我们还等什么？

lines.en: scene chikawakesup19
: I was...
lines.zh: : 我刚才……

lines.en: : Kinda just hoping to...
lines.zh: : 有点只是想……

lines.en: : Oh! Good morning, you two.
lines.zh: : 哦！两位早上好。

lines.en: scene chikawakesup20
: Oh, hey!
lines.zh: : 哦，你好！

lines.en: : I was just hoping I’d run into you one last time.
lines.zh: : 我正希望临走前能再碰上你们一次。

lines.en: : Another example of fate, perhaps?
lines.zh: : 说不定，这又是命运的一次安排？

lines.en: scene chikawakesup21
: Good morning, Mister.
lines.zh: : 早上好，先生。

lines.en: : Would you be willing to discuss with me what game you two were playing last night?
lines.zh: : 您愿不愿意跟我讲讲，你们俩昨晚在玩什么游戏？

lines.en: : It sounded very exciting.
lines.zh: : 听起来非常刺激。

lines.en: : Tsukasa...how many times do I have to tell you? They were playing a game for adults.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa……我都跟你说过多少遍了？他们玩的是大人的游戏。

lines.en: : You...uhh...
: You heard all that?
lines.zh: : 你们全听见了？

lines.en: scene chikawakesup22
: You two...sure are lively.
lines.zh: : 你们俩……可真精神。

lines.en: : Hahah...hah...hah...
: This totally isn’t embarrassing at all...
lines.zh: : 这真的一点都不尴尬……

lines.en: : I am...sorry you had to hear all that.
lines.zh: : 我……很抱歉让你们听见那些。

lines.en: : Oh, there’s no need to apologize.
lines.zh: : 哦，没必要道歉。

lines.en: : Lovers will be lovers.
lines.zh: : 恋人就是恋人嘛。

lines.en: scene chikawakesup23
: And Chika, dear...I forgot to bring it up yesterday, but I’d be happy to exchange contact information with you in the event that you’d want to meet up for lunch or something of the sort.
lines.zh: : 还有 Chika 姑娘……昨天忘了提，不过要是你想约着一起吃个午饭什么的，我很乐意跟你交换联系方式。

lines.en: scene chikawakesup24
: Please forgive me if I’m overstepping my bounds by saying that.
lines.zh: : 如果我这么说冒昧了，还请原谅。

lines.en: : No! Not at all! I’d like, totally love that!
lines.zh: : 不！一点都不！我超级乐意的！

lines.en: : How about I leave you two alone for a little while?
lines.zh: : 要不，我给你们俩留点时间单独待一会儿？

lines.en: : To say goodbye, I mean.
lines.zh: : 我是说，道个别。

lines.en: scene chikawakesup25
: I’ll only be a few minutes. I promise.
lines.zh: : 我就几分钟就好。我保证。

lines.en: : No worries. I’ll just wait outside.
lines.zh: : 不着急。我就在外面等。

lines.en: : It was nice meeting you.
lines.zh: : 很高兴认识你。

lines.en: : It’s been a pleasure meeting you as well. Truly.
lines.zh: : 我也真的很高兴认识你。真心的。

lines.en: : Bye-bye! Please try to be a little more quiet when you play games in the future!
lines.zh: : 拜拜！以后玩游戏请尽量小声一点哦！

lines.en: : Right...
scene black
I head outside and come to terms with the trip being over.
lines.zh: 我走到外面，慢慢接受了这趟旅行结束这件事。

lines.en: Chika spends the next five or so minutes talking to the girls inside.
lines.zh: Chika 在里面又跟那两个女孩聊了大约五分钟。

lines.en: And while I can’t say for certain that I understand why, I’ve got a pretty good idea.
lines.zh: 虽然我不能说自己完全明白为什么，但我大概猜得到。

lines.en: Teenage girls are fragile.
lines.zh: 十几岁的女孩是脆弱的。

lines.en: Sometimes, they require fully grown specimens to latch onto so they don’t float off into the air and get sucked into a jet engine.
lines.zh: 有时候，她们需要抓住一个完全长成的成年人，这样才不会飘上天、被吸进飞机引擎里。

lines.en: I don’t think Chika is close to floating away any time soon.
lines.zh: 我觉得 Chika 短时间内还不会飘走。

lines.en: Especially now that the two of us are...whatever we are.
lines.zh: 尤其现在咱俩已经……不管算什么关系了。

lines.en: I’m sure our respective answers to that would be slightly different.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，我俩对这件事的答案会有点不一样。

lines.en: But I’m glad she seems to have found someone else to latch onto.
lines.zh: 但我很高兴，她好像找到了另一个可以抓住的人。

lines.en: Frankly, I’d like to latch onto Tsubasa as well.
lines.zh: 说真的，我也想抓住 Tsubasa。

lines.en: Albeit in an immensely less wholesome way.
lines.zh: 只不过方式要远远不那么清纯。

lines.en: But thoughts like that will have to wait until there aren’t feelings at stake.
lines.zh: 但这种念头，得等到没有感情在火上烤的时候再说。

lines.en: For now...I’ll just-
lines.zh: 眼下……我就——

lines.en: I see a group of cats off in the distance.
lines.zh: 我看见远处有一群猫。

Chika’s affection has increased to [chika_love]!
lines.zh: Chika 的好感度上升到了 [chika_love]！

lines.en: The trip to the onsen has come to an end.
lines.zh: 温泉之旅结束了。

lines.en: You have received a photo from Chika to commemorate the occasion!
lines.zh: 你收到了 Chika 为纪念这次旅行发来的照片！

lines.en: My stop comes first.
lines.zh: 我的站先到了。

lines.en: I get off the bus and watch Chika fade from my sight.
lines.zh: 我下了车，看着 Chika 从我视线里渐渐远去。

lines.en: But not before giving her a few thousand yen for a morning after pill.
lines.zh: 但在那之前，我先给了她几千日元去买事后避孕药。
